== Description ==

[[Joe Horbey]] (left, dark denim shirt, chevron mustache, longer brown hair, reaching for a card) and [[Ken Cross]] (right, glasses, receding hair, dark hoodie, pointing at the board) at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 4 October 2025.
